correctness.rationale: With the standard optimal scalar Zak symbol for redundancy two, the exact even/odd decomposition and uniformly exponentially small remaining tails give global S=2(g(x)^2+g(1-x)^2)+o(g(1/2)^2) on the central half-cell. The other half is exponentially larger. Convexity of g^2 for lambda large forces the minimum at the midpoint to leading order. At the window peak, the upper symbol tends to 2, and 0<g<=1 bounds it globally. The highest polynomial coefficient gives the precise limit, and all quantifiers fix integer m before lambda diverges. Standalone code produced 17,300 finite corroborating checks; experiments are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The exact sharp lower-bound asymptotic and limiting upper bound quantify noise amplification in high-concentration oversampled Gabor reconstruction for a complete natural hierarchy of integer-order Matérn/Bessel-potential windows. Factorial constants and the polynomial power distinguish smoothing orders. The result localizes the global worst-conditioned Zak fiber and is not merely a sufficient frame estimate or fixed-point local approximation.
